name: io.github.flow-steward/honcho
title: Honcho
description: Maintain persistent knowledge about users and conversations with Honcho. Store messages, create or search conclusions, and remove individual conclusions in your workspace.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key from app.honcho.dev. Enter as: Bearer <Honcho API key>

headers.name: X-Honcho-Workspace-ID
headers.description: Optional default workspace ID. If omitted, the agent must pass workspace_id on each workspace-scoped tool call.
